<script setup lang="ts">
import {
  AccordionRoot,
  type AccordionRootEmits,
  type AccordionRootProps,
  useForwardPropsEmits,
} from 'reka-ui';

const props = defineProps<AccordionRootProps>();
const emits = defineEmits<AccordionRootEmits>();

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
  <AccordionRoot v-bind="forwarded"
  data-slot="accordion">
    <slot />
  </AccordionRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AccordionItem, type AccordionItemProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const props = defineProps<AccordionItemProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);
</script>

<template>
  <AccordionItem
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn('border-b', $attrs.class ?? '')"
   data-slot="accordion-item">
    <slot />
  </AccordionItem>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AccordionHeader, AccordionTrigger, type AccordionTriggerProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { ChevronDownIcon } from 'lucide-vue-next';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const props = defineProps<AccordionTriggerProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);

defineSlots<{
  /** The trigger label. */
  default?: () => unknown;
  /** Replaces the chevron icon that rotates when the item opens. */
  icon?: () => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <AccordionHeader class="flex">
    <AccordionTrigger
      v-bind="forwarded"
      data-slot="accordion-trigger"
      :class="cn('flex flex-1 items-center justify-between py-4 font-medium transition-all [&[data-state=open]>svg]:rotate-180', $attrs.class ?? '')"
    >
      <slot />
      <slot name="icon">
        <ChevronDownIcon
          class="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 transition-transform duration-200"
        />
      </slot>
    </AccordionTrigger>
  </AccordionHeader>
</template>
